accessions.GSE277549: whole-muscle small RNA-seq (S2.12.p1) - not requested, not analysed here

assay.GSE220280: NEBNext small RNA libraries from RNase-A-treated anti-TOM22 immunoprecipitated mitochondria; NovaSeq 2x51, read1; fastp + blastn (word 19) vs miRBase v22.1 mature; perl read counts (S2.8.p1, S2.11.p1, S2.12.p1)
assay.GSE276889: TruSeq stranded total RNA RiboZero, NovaSeq 2x150; kallisto 0.46.1 vs GRCh38.p13 Ensembl, transcript counts summed to gene; genes with mean < 10 reads excluded (S2.13.p1)

sample_inclusion: 12 healthy males, 60 min cycling at 70% VO2peak; vastus lateralis biopsies pre, immediately post, 3 h post (S2.1.p1, S2.4.p1)
mitochondria: 33 libraries, pre n=9, post n=12, 3h n=12; 3 pre libraries failed QC (S2.8.p1, FIG1)
mRNA: pre n=10, post n=12, 3h n=11 (SUP1 Figure S5 legend)
five high-miRNA-fraction mitochondrial libraries from 2 participants retained (S3.2.p1, SUP1 Figure S6)
primary_estimand: Within-subject change in expression after one bout of acute endurance cycling: immediately post vs pre, 3 h post vs pre, and 3 h post vs immediately post, for (a) whole-muscle mRNA (GSE276889) and (b) miRNA in isolated skeletal-muscle mitochondria (GSE220280).

planned_contrasts.name: time_post3h_vs_post0h
planned_contrasts.definition: 3 h post vs immediately post ('relative to pre- or immediately post-exercise')

blocking_or_covariance.paper: DESeq2 design formula not reported. The paper uses linear mixed models with participant as random effect for read-count QC (S2.12.p1) and figure annotations (FIG3, FIG5); SUP1 Figure S6 notes 'after correction for repeated measures'.

matrix_scale.GSE276889: kallisto gene-level counts, deposited as integers

paper_method: DESeq2 (v1.36 in Methods; v1.48.2 in Table S1-S3 legends) on raw counts; prefilter: < 10 normalized counts across all samples removed (S2.14.p1)

enrichment.method: GO BP over-representation of mRNAs from mirTarRnaSeq miRNA-mRNA interrelations (p<0.05)
